meta.robustness: level/edge band = observed range over all healthy epochs +/- max(6sig,30ADU) (legacy median +/- max(6sig,15ADU) for 2.B.Green SLOW, whose 2026-10-14 records are held out); structure/rms/saturation caps max(1.5 x max, med+8sig, floor) from the vetted epochs only (level-only: 2026-10-14)
meta.structure_norm: structure / (full_mean - edge_med), heavy-tail cap, records with signal < 2.0 ADU excluded; FAST+SLOW pooled for CAL.R-ARC
meta.smear: col_med_smooth_std / (full_mean - edge_med) (std of the per-column median profile after a 15-column running median, over the lamp signal), cap max(med+8sig, 1.5 x p95), records with signal < 20.0 ADU or without the statistic excluded; FAST+SLOW pooled for CAL.R-ARC
